e.title: Insurance Chatbot (Llama 3 微调)
e.summary: 保险领域聊天机器人微调项目：Llama 3 ChatQA 微调，生产级领域对话
e.body: Insurance-Chatbot-Fine-tuning-GPT2-Llama3（tajmahal226）是保险领域对话模型微调项目：基于 Nvidia Llama 3 ChatQA 架构微调，针对保险问答/对话任务，附带微调流程。对 RIAA：保险 LLM 微调的完整入门样例——从数据到部署的生产路径；与 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]（保险问答语料，微调数据源）、[[finance-llms]]（金融 LLM 谱系）、[[ins-actbench]]（领域评测）配套：数据 → 微调 → 评测全链路；适合课程项目与毕业设计参考。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：GitHub 确认（Llama 3 ChatQA 微调、保险领域对话），未实测
e.summary_en: Insurance-domain chatbot fine-tuning project: Llama 3 ChatQA fine-tuned, production-grade domain dialogue
e.summary_hk: 保險領域聊天機械人微調項目：Llama 3 ChatQA 微調，生產級領域對話
e.body_en: Insurance-Chatbot-Fine-tuning-GPT2-Llama3 (tajmahal226) is an insurance-domain dialogue-model fine-tuning project: fine-tuned on the Nvidia Llama 3 ChatQA architecture for insurance Q&A/conversation, with the full fine-tuning pipeline included. For RIAA: a complete beginner example of insurance LLM fine-tuning — the production path from data to deployment; paired with [[insuranceqa-corpus]] (insurance QA corpus as fine-tuning data), [[finance-llms]] (the financial-LLM lineage) and [[ins-actbench]] (domain evaluation): data → fine-tune → evaluate end to end; a good reference for course projects and final-year theses.
e.body_hk: Insurance-Chatbot-Fine-tuning-GPT2-Llama3（tajmahal226）是保險領域對話模型微調項目：基於 Nvidia Llama 3 ChatQA 架構微調，針對保險問答/對話任務，附帶微調流程。對 RIAA：保險 LLM 微調的完整入門樣例——從數據到部署的生產路徑；與 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]（保險問答語料，微調數據源）、[[finance-llms]]（金融 LLM 譜系）、[[ins-actbench]]（領域評測）配套：數據 → 微調 → 評測全鏈路；適合課程項目與畢業設計參考。
